## Fixes

- Received files go to your system Downloads folder, also when you moved it (Windows) or set it with `XDG_DOWNLOAD_DIR` (Linux). Before, Dotlink used `Downloads` in your home folder.
- The PC window's pages shrink with a narrow window instead of being cut off.

## Updating

This is the first release the apps can update to by themselves. On 0.1.0-beta.1, open Settings → About on the PC or Settings → Check for updates on the phone.
